items.subject: Summary of failures for Google Apps Script: Gemini Email Triage
items.summary: Automated failure digest reports 97 failed runs because the processInbox function is still missing; this is the same unresolved issue already reported.
items.action: Open the Apps Script project directly, restore or rename processInbox or update/remove the obsolete trigger, then test it manually and confirm scheduled runs succeed.
items.decisionNeeded: Decide whether to restore or rename processInbox, or remove/update the obsolete 15-minute trigger.
